$comment: Six organizations, one per category in src/db/enums.ts, so Discover Orgs has something in every filter. Officer and adviser terms all start at the top of the current school year; the script sets the dates.

organizations.name: Samahang Agham
organizations.mission: Science investigatory projects, quiz bees, and the annual fair. Open to any learner willing to be curious out loud.

organizations.name: Sining Guild
organizations.mission: Visual arts, chorale, and the stage crew that makes every school programme work.

organizations.name: Palaro Athletics Club
organizations.mission: Intramurals, the district meet, and training that welcomes beginners as loudly as it welcomes varsity.

organizations.name: Bayanihan Service Corps
organizations.mission: Coastal clean-ups, feeding programmes, and the reading buddies scheme with the nearby elementary school.

organizations.name: Sinag Fellowship
organizations.mission: Morning reflections and outreach, run to be welcoming to learners of any faith or none.

organizations.name: Robotika Circuit Club
organizations.mission: Line followers, microcontrollers, and one very patient soldering iron. No prior experience assumed.
